Hii! Your art is really pretty and cute!
I would love if you could draw my vtuber character, krum!

She's a fisherman catgirl, but she's really bad at fishing!
She can be very clumsy, that's why her tail is broken and she has bandaids on her body!
She wears a tuna can hat, but she hates eating fish! She's silly, cheerful and can get easily flustered!
The sleeves are slightly poofy, but still slender! There's an image detailing it in my references!

Please draw her in any poses and outfits you like! 
Here are my references:
https://imgur.com/a/vmGrpRN

銀（白髪）

華が去った後、彼女はひとりで同族を探す旅に出た。
 
華（紫髪）
華は幼少期の生活が苦しかったため、性格は傲慢で率直ではない。
彼女は銀と同じ魔法少女で、身元を隠すためかつて銀と共に生活し、二人で苦しくも思い出に残る日々を過ごした。
